jobs.title: Automation & GenAI Engineer
jobs.description:
Rotterdam \+ Den Haag·Fulltime


  
Je hebt AI\-prototypes gebouwd. Nu wil je het moeilijkere werk doen: zorgen dat ze betrouwbaar genoeg zijn voor de echte operatie.


Bij WARP werk je in kleine senior teams aan digitale producten met gevolgen buiten je laptop. Je eerste uitdaging ligt binnen een complex, datarijk programma waar tempo, zorgvuldigheid en goed beoordelingsvermogen tegelijk tellen. Je bouwt en verbetert oplossingen rond LLM's, koppelt ze via REST API's aan bestaande systemen en zorgt dat wat je oplevert ook echt in productie werkt.


Je pakt backendwerk, pipelines en integraties op, ziet waar processen slimmer kunnen en vertaalt dat naar praktische stappen. Minstens zo belangrijk: je kunt uitleggen wat de techniek doet, waarom een keuze is gemaakt en waar de grenzen liggen — zonder je achter jargon te verschuilen.


Dit is hands\-on engineering in een omgeving met veel stakeholders en weinig ruimte voor theater. We hebben plek voor twee mensen.


**Over jou**
------------


* Minstens één jaar hands\-on ervaring in een vergelijkbare AI\- of automatiseringsrol
* Sterke programmeervaardigheden en praktische ervaring met LLM's, backendontwikkeling en REST\-integraties
* Comfortabel in complexe, datarijke omgevingen
* Een afgeronde WO\-master
* Uitstekend Nederlands, mondeling én schriftelijk — dit is een harde eis
* In staat om technische keuzes helder uit te leggen aan niet\-technische stakeholders
* Gevoelig voor context: je begrijpt dat timing, afstemming en vertrouwen soms net zo belangrijk zijn als het technisch perfecte antwoord
* Ervaring met LangChain, LlamaIndex, Python, PyTorch, Keras, Azure OpenAI of Document Intelligence is een plus
* Een verbetermentaliteit: nieuwsgierig, pragmatisch en nooit uitgeleerd
**Perks**
---------


* Een plek bij WARP met vanaf dag één een inhoudelijk stevige uitdaging
* Senior collega's, veel vertrouwen en echte ownership
* Werk waarin AI verder komt dan slides en demo's
* Hybride werken, met Rotterdam als thuisbasis en Den Haag voor deze uitdaging
* Ruimte om de diepte in te gaan, breder te groeien of een onverwachte afslag te nemen
**Wat kan je**
--------------


* GenAI
* LLMs
* Python
* REST
* APIs
* Azure
* Automation
**Over ons**
------------


We zijn een Rotterdams team van ervaren engineers, designers en strategen. We bouwen digitale producten en strategieën voor organisaties waar het werk ertoe doet: havens, ziekenhuizen, supply chains en energienetwerken. Soms brengen we het team, soms sluiten we aan waar onze expertise het verschil maakt. Hoe dan ook blijven we dicht op het echte werk. Kleine teams, hoge inzet, eerlijke gesprekken. Bewijs jij liever dingen dan dat je ze presenteert? Dan pas je hier.

jobs.description:
Contact
  
  

Heb je vragen over de functie of wil je direct reageren? Neem contact op met Robert van Hest.
  
  

Robert van Hest
  
  

r.vanhest@kennisnet.nl 06\-21 55 04 29
  
  

Een landelijk platform ontstaan uit een samenwerking met partner SIVON een extra impuls geven? Die impact heb jij als netwerk engineer bij Kennisnet in Zoetermeer. Hoe? Doordat jouw primaire focus ligt op de dienst: Veilig Internet. Het is de basisinfrastructuur voor het onderwijs, gelegen in de datacenters van het nationale dienstencentrum. Ga jij onze ambitieuze doelstellingen om ruim 2500 schoollocaties/800\.000 leerlingen te voorzien in veilig en hoogwaardig internet helpen te verwezenlijken?
  
Wat ga je doen?
  
  

De basis staat voor de dienst Veilig Internet, die in juni 2020 landelijk is uitgerold. Jij schakelt met IT\-coördinatoren van scholen, schoolbesturen en hun IT beheerpartijen omtrent wensen en eisen. Deze zet jij om in voorstellen en ontwerpen waar niet alleen jijzelf maar ook jouw teamcollega’s en betrokkenen van SIVON mee vooruit kunnen. Op basis van verzamelde input draag je samen met hen zorg voor het opstellen van een high level design en van firewall policies \& profiles voor nieuwe aansluitingen.
  
  

Ook kun jij verwachtingen van stakeholders goed managen door heldere kaders richting hen te stellen. Regulier contact onderhouden met onze technische leverancier gaat je als vanzelfsprekend goed af. Je ondersteunt hen dan ook op afstand bij de omzetting bij scholen die de overstap maken naar Veilig Internet.
  
Wat is Kennisnet?
  
  

Het onderwijs kan niet meer zonder ICT, zowel in de klas als in de bedrijfsvoering. Digitalisering is cruciaal om talenten van leerlingen en studenten tot bloei te brengen en noodzakelijk om het onderwijs goed te kunnen organiseren. Maar ICT brengt ook veel uitdagingen en dilemma’s met zich mee. Bijvoorbeeld op het vlak van privacy, cybersecurity, leermiddelen en digitale geletterdheid. Kennisnet is de gids die het Nederlandse onderwijs wegwijs maakt in het professioneel inzetten van ICT. Zowel bij het leren als in de bedrijfsvoering.
  
  

Wij onderzoeken en brengen advies uit. Niet aan één individuele school of docent, maar – en dat maakt ons werk zo leuk – direct aan alle scholen en besturen. Of aan het ministerie van OCW, sectorraden en andere landelijke organisaties. Jouw impact reikt dus heel ver. En dan werk je ook nog in een publieke organisatie vol (politieke) dynamiek én ruimte voor jouw initiatief.
  
Welke kwaliteiten breng je mee?
  
  

Je beschikt over een sterk analytisch vermogen en een flexibele instelling. Daarnaast ben je pragmatisch ingesteld waardoor je ingewikkelde problemen simpel kunt overbrengen, beschrijven, oplossen. Je beschikt over een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift en bent communicatief vaardig. Overdracht en opleveringen voorzie je van duidelijke documentatie. Jij kunt zelfstandig maar ook goed samenwerken, zowel in\- als extern. Uiteraard heb je passie voor je werk.
  
  

**Ook heb je:**  

HBO\-denkniveau, een opleiding in de richting van ICT of minimaal een Fortinet Certified Professional\-certificering (voorheen NSE 4\).
  
  

Enkele jaren ervaring met configuratie van Fortinet firewalls (voor meerdere klanten/remote)
  
  

Kennis van FortiManager en FortiAnalyzer is een pre.
  
  

Wat krijg je hiervoor terug?
  
  

Veel! Werken bij Kennisnet betekent werken in een fascinerende omgeving die – net als het onderwijs – nooit stilstaat. Vind jij het leuk om steeds nieuwe kennis op te doen en eigen initiatieven vorm te geven, dan kun je bij ons je hart ophalen. En dat ook nog in een betrokken en open team van netwerkspecialisten en technisch beheerpartijen.
  
  

**Verder kun je rekenen op:**  

25 vakantiedagen en een brutomaandsalaris tussen € 3\.888,89 en € 5\.373,47 bij een 40\-urige werkweek. Het exacte salaris hangt af van je ervaring en kwaliteiten.
  
  

8% vakantiegeld én een flexbudget van 10% van je maandsalaris dat je kunt gebruiken voor bijvoorbeeld extra verlofdagen (maximaal 26\) of kunt laten uitkeren.
  
  

In eerste instantie een jaarcontract. Ben je bij ons op je plek, dan is verlenging voor bepaalde of onbepaalde tijd mogelijk.
  
  

Flexibele werktijden. En je kiest zelf de werkplek die het beste bij je werkzaamheden past.
  
  

Een hoge pensioenbijdrage vanuit Kennisnet.
  
  

Een opleidingsbudget van gemiddeld € 2\.475,\- per jaar.
  
  

Een goede reiskostenvergoeding.
  
  

Een bijdrage aan je aanvullende zorgverzekering.
  
  

Een thuiswerkvergoeding van € 80,\- netto per maand, ongeacht het aantal uren dat je (thuis)werkt.
  
  

Een laptop of bijdrage voor een eigen device naar keuze.
  
  

Lees meer over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.
  
Past deze uitdaging helemaal bij jou?
  
  

Neem dan voor een eerste kennismaking contact op met onze recruiter, Robert van Hest. Samen kunnen jullie dan verkennen of deze rol en Kennisnet als werkgever bij jou passen. Hij vertelt je uiteraard ook graag meer over het sollicitatieproces. Een geldige Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) is onderdeel van deze aanstellingsprocedure.
  
  

Robert is bereikbaar via r.vanhest@kennisnet.nl of telefonisch op 06\-21550429\.

GLA00007P Requisition \#  

Graduate Civil \& Structural Engineer: Energy, Maritime \& Civil Infrastructure


See it differently \- Early Careers at Arup


See it differently


You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.


Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities.


The Opportunity


We are looking for graduate Civil \& Structural Engineers who are interested in playing a key role in the design and delivery of critical infrastructure on a diverse range of projects.

  

Joining Arup is an excellent opportunity for a Graduate Engineer to gain practical experience across a wide range of projects and sectors, providing extensive and varied learning opportunities for professional growth. You will be embedded within our project delivery teams working closely with a range of staff, from recent graduates to experienced engineers and technical specialists, who will provide you with the support and encouragement required to develop your skills and your career.

  

Our Civil Engineering team works at the heart of projects that create lasting positive change across a variety of sectors including renewable energy, power transmission, water, site development, maritime and defence. We deliver a broad range of small / medium scale and major infrastructure projects. Typical examples include; pumped storage hydro schemes, HVDC transmission infrastructure, onshore \& offshore wind developments, coastal resilience schemes, ports and harbour upgrades, major wastewater utility renewals and defence infrastructure.

  

If you have a preference or interest for any of the sectors or project types mentioned above, please discuss this in your application. However, we equally accept that you might not know at this stage or may be open to a variety of opportunities. The broad range of work that we undertake provides a great environment to explore these areas further.

  

In this role you will:

  

* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of engineers, environmental specialists, planners and project managers to develop integrated engineering solutions.
* Work alongside experienced engineers and gain hands\-on experience in the design and delivery of a variety of civil engineering works, including for example civil \& marine structures, foundations, HVDC power transmission and site development infrastructure, earthworks, drainage, roads and utilities.
* Use industry\-leading digital tools and develop skills in a range of engineering analysis and design software.
* Contribute to projects that have a lasting impact on the UK's net\-zero ambitions.
* Undertake technical assessments, engineering design calculations, site inspections and preparation of reports, drawings and project deliverables.
* Develop professional and technical skills through structured training, mentoring and hands\-on project experience while supporting the delivery of sustainable infrastructure.
* Be supported towards becoming professionally qualified and achieving Chartered status with the ICE or IStructE. You will be assigned a Delegated Engineer (DE) and Supervising Civil Engineer (SCE) and be provided with the necessary experience and training to deepen your skills and progress your professional qualifications.

https://www.arup.com/services/civil\-engineering/


https://www.arup.com/markets/transport/maritime/


https://www.arup.com/markets/energy/energy\-storage/


https://www.arup.com/markets/energy/transmission\-distribution/

  

Is this role right for you?


For this opportunity, we are seeking the following qualifications, skills and attributes:

  

* Masters level (MEng or MSc) in a relevant academic discipline, such as Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Ground / Geotechnical Engineering.
* Enthusiasm for a career in the renewable energy, power transmission, water, maritime, defence and/or site development sectors, underpinned by knowledge and interest in one or more of these areas.
* An analytical thought process and drive for technical excellence.
* Creativity and a desire to think beyond the norm.
* Aptitude to work on your own initiative, be proactive and take responsibility.
* A good communicator and proactive team player who thrives working individually and in a team environment.
* Interest in and application of digital skills is an advantage.
* A willingness to develop expertise through on the job and formal learning, internal research opportunities, and collaboration with colleagues.
* Interested in developing your career in Engineering, with a desire to gain Professional Qualification as a Chartered Civil Engineer, Chartered Structural Engineer, or equivalent
* Knowledge of civil engineering, geotechnical, drainage, highway, earthworks, structural, and hydraulic engineering principles.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, technical reporting, and engineering calculation skills.
* Experience with AutoCAD, Civil 3D, GIS (ArcGIS/QGIS), Microsoft Excel, and digital engineering tools.
* Awareness of BIM and ISO 19650 standards; familiarity with Revit is desirable.

To be considered for a graduate opportunity, your application must include a copy of your academic transcript and meet the following criteria:


* Full working rights in the country of application
* No more than 12 months of full\-time experience in a comparable role
* Recently graduated, or on track to graduate, from your most recent degree, related to your role of choice, before employment starts.

Alongside your degree, we look for the following core attributes:


* Changemakers: A passion for sustainable development and creating a better world is key.
* Innovative minds: We’re looking for critical thinkers who embrace new ideas and challenge the status quo.
* Growth seekers: You have a growth mindset, always eager to learn and explore new ways of working.
* Adaptable adventurers: You’re ready to take on any challenge that comes your way.

Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. Early application is recommended.
  

  

Eligibility
  

Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Therefore, you must ensure that you are eligible to work permanently in the UK without our sponsorship.


What we offer you


At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.


Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.


We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling permanent members to share in the results of our collective efforts.


We take an approach to flexible working that supports the diversity and wellbeing of our graduates.


We also provide for our permanent members Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.


Next Steps


We've designed our application process to be straightforward and supportive, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills and potential. Applications are reviewed as they're received, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.


The process includes an online application, psychometric testing, application review, case study, interview and offer stage. Our friendly Early Careers team is available throughout the process to answer questions and help you feel confident every step of the way.


Different people, shared values


Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas \- this drives our excellence.


Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross\-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ\+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your\-life\-at\-arup. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas.
  

  

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact UKEarlyCareersRecruitment@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

carloans 365 is a fast\-growing, industry\-leading car finance broker based in Sale, just 10 minutes from Manchester City Centre.

Our mission is simple: to empower our customers by securing the best finance deals tailored to their needs, helping them drive away in their perfect car. With rapid growth and a reputation for delivering exceptional customer service, we pride ourselves on making car finance quick, easy and hassle\-free. Join us at carloans 365, where customer satisfaction drives our success.

**ENOUGH ABOUT US, WHAT'S THE ROLE?**

Technology is central to the next stage of our growth. We're building and improving bespoke internal platforms, customer and operational tools, CRM and telephony integrations, automation, AI\-enabled services and data solutions that support teams across the business.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who can take genuine ownership of software from idea to production. You'll work closely with our Head of Technical Operations and senior stakeholders to understand what the business needs, turn those requirements into well\-designed technical solutions, and then build, test, deploy and continuously improve them. This is a hands\-on role for someone equally comfortable creating intuitive front\-end experiences and building the back\-end services, databases, APIs and integrations behind them.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Designing, building and owning bespoke web applications, internal platforms, tools and services from initial requirement and technical design through to production deployment and ongoing improvement
* Building responsive, accessible and intuitive front\-end applications using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript practices
* Designing and developing robust back\-end services, business logic and APIs using modern server\-side technologies such as Node.js/TypeScript, C\#/.NET, Python or equivalent
* Designing, querying and optimising relational databases, including SQL data models and reliable data flows between systems
* Creating secure integrations between internal applications and third\-party platforms including CRM, telephony, AI services, lenders, reporting tools and other business systems
* Working directly with operational teams and senior stakeholders to understand problems, challenge requirements where appropriate and translate them into practical technical solutions
* Owning the full software development lifecycle including scoping, architecture, development, code review, testing, deployment, monitoring, support and iteration
* Building reusable components, services and integration patterns that provide a scalable technical foundation for future growth
* Building security, privacy and auditability into applications from the outset, including authentication, role\-based access, logging and secure handling of customer and commercially sensitive data
* Mentoring less experienced developers or technical team members and helping establish strong engineering practices across the team

**SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE**

**Essential Technical Skills**

* Strong commercial full\-stack software engineering experience, with evidence of personally delivering production software across both front\-end and back\-end development
* Strong React experience together with modern JavaScript and/or TypeScript, HTML and CSS
* Strong back\-end development experience with a modern technology such as Node.js/TypeScript, C\#/.NET, Python or equivalent
* Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema design, querying, performance considerations and data integrity
* Experience designing, building and consuming REST APIs and integrating multiple third\-party systems
* Experience taking software from requirements through architecture, build, automated testing, deployment and ongoing production support
* Strong Git/version\-control practices, including branching, pull requests and code review, together with experience of automated testing
* Experience deploying and operating applications in a cloud environment such as Azure, AWS or equivalent, including CI/CD, monitoring and secure software development practices

**Working Style \& Mindset**

* Ownership mindset: comfortable being responsible for a solution end to end rather than only one layer of the stack
* Commercially minded: able to understand the operational problem behind a request and build the solution that creates the most value
* Pragmatic problem\-solver: able to move quickly without sacrificing security, reliability or maintainability
* Confident communicator: able to explain technical decisions, risks and trade\-offs clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Self\-directed and proactive: comfortable working in a growing technical function where not every requirement will arrive perfectly defined
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, FCA\-regulated environment where data quality, customer outcomes, controls and auditability matter

**Desirable (but not required)**

* Experience building software within financial services, fintech, motor finance, insurance or another regulated environment
* Experience with contact\-centre or telephony platforms such as ConnexAI, Twilio, Five9 or similar
* Experience with Azure/AWS, CI/CD, Docker or modern application hosting patterns
* Practical experience integrating AI/LLM services, CRM platforms, real\-time systems, queues, webhooks or event\-driven architecture

**WHAT THE ROLE ISN’T**

This isn't a front\-end\-only, back\-end\-only or systems\-administration role. We need someone who can understand a business problem and build the complete solution around it. You'll be expected to work across the application, database, API and integration layers, take responsibility for what happens after deployment, ask the right questions and help us decide the best way to build solutions around how carloans 365 actually operates.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Genuine ownership of products and systems that have a direct impact on how the business operates
* Opportunity to build bespoke technology rather than simply maintain legacy or off\-the\-shelf systems
* Direct exposure to senior decision\-making and the ability to influence technical direction and architecture
* A varied engineering environment spanning customer journeys, internal operations, CRM, telephony, AI, automation and data
* Opportunity to help establish engineering standards and shape the technical team as the business continues to grow

**DETAILS**

* £70,000 \- £80,000 per annum (DOE)
* Working pattern: 09:00 – 18:00, 5 days per week, Monday – Friday
* 28 days holiday (bank holidays are normal working days) \+ 1 additional day off for your birthday

* Employee Car Scheme: access to our exclusive employee car scheme
* Employee Assistance Programme (EAP): confidential support and guidance when you need it
* Company Events
